app.re: not in the verified index; not served

entries.reason: A schedule file whose locator does not decode to an indexed document path is not a package asset, so the app shows it as not in the verified index and does not serve it, where v5 links the file on disk. A separate unit is to index these files as verified package assets (shared-file request in the CC-09 report).
